reason: The core claim holds. ledger.md (regenerated 02:25:51Z) confirms: non-CI safetail L 6.87-7.81 h (exp70a/exp78a 6.87-7.04 up to exp70q 7.64-7.81); CI exp79a (00:06Z) 9.27-9.45 and exp87a (12:14Z) 9.30-9.48. There is no upward trend over 26-28 Sep. Time of day moves L by at most ~0.2-0.3 h, and that is confounded with build content (CI night vs day +0.03 h). So the v3 (g)6 guess of more than 10 h did not happen through 28 Sep. Any real final-day surge would come near 23:59Z, after the 20:00Z tick. The finding changes no rule, and the existing rules already handle a late file (P '?' -> A-M1 UNUSED; an unread file is never a final). Four details are wrong. (1) Only 15 COMPLETE rows fall on 26-28 Sep. The count reaches 17 only with exp57/exp57b from 25 Sep. (2) exp89p's margin to the 08:40Z header is 0.70 h measured against exp85a's L_hi of 7.19 h. Against the family maximum of 7.81 h it is only ~0.08 h, with no queue growth at all. The freeze read window (07:38-08:35Z) already encodes this. (3) At the proposed 07:23Z prep, none of the night files is terminal (exp89p ~07:38-08:35Z, exp89r ~09:25Z, exp75 ~09:05-10:05Z), so only pending lower bounds exist then. (4) A 0.5 h delta against the parent is inside same-family build jitter: exp70g vs exp85a differ by 0.48 h, exp78a vs exp78b by 0.40 h on the same night. The proposed '19:40Z' also contradicts the user-logged '~19:30 UTC read-by' line (CONTEXT 28 Sep 10:19Z) and the 19:43Z reminder. Private or public score value: none, this is ops only.
fix: Accept as INFO, with no rule change and no Kaggle calls. Amend the action: (a) evaluate the delta at each night file's terminal header, not at 07:23Z (exp89p ~07:38-08:40Z; exp89r/exp75 ~09:05-10:50Z). At 07:23Z log only the pending L lower bounds. (b) Fire the card line only if the night L_lo exceeds the family range maximum (non-CI 7.81 h, CI 9.48 h) by more than 0.5 h, not the parent's L_hi. That keeps build jitter from triggering it. (c) The card line reads: 'M2/A-M1 read due at submit + L_parent_hi + delta; a read after ~19:30Z (22:30 MSK) cannot be a final' (keep the user's 19:30Z, not 19:40Z). (d) Correct the count to 15 rows on 26-28 Sep (17 including 25 Sep). (e) State exp89p's real margin: ~0.1-0.7 h depending on jitter, already covered by the 08:40Z header rule -> UNUSED.
